# Tech&Res politics: post-1936 movements - GENERATED by scripts/politics/ztrpol_gen_movements.py
# Pole factors on creation and support: civil society movements need liberty, reactive ones oppose the prevailing order

movement_ztrpol_environmentalist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	ideology = ideology_ztrpol_environmentalist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_green
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_green
			scope:interest_group ?= {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate_ambientalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_extreme_ambientalist
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_green
				}
			}
			multiply = 5
		}
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = ambientalism
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = { # A neighbouring country with this movement and more prestige makes it more likely
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						prestige > ROOT.prestige
						any_political_movement = { is_political_movement_type = movement_ztrpol_environmentalist }
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_country_pollution_per_million > 4000 }
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_un_environment_norm = yes }
			multiply = 1.25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_social_pole = yes }
			multiply = 1.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes }
			multiply = 0.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes }
			multiply = 0.5
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_pop_type = slaves }
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_clerks
		movement_support_engineers
		movement_support_peasants
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_ztrpol_pollution
		movement_support_ztrpol_un_environment
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 10
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = academics }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = clerks }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_CLERKS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = engineers }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_ENGINEERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = peasants }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = farmers }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_FARMERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = upper }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = middle }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = lower }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { state.ztrpol_state_pollution_per_million > 2000 }
			multiply = { # x1 at 2000, x2 from 10000 per million inhabitants
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pollution"
				value = state.ztrpol_state_pollution_per_million
				subtract = 2000
				divide = 8000
				max = 1
				add = 1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_un_environment_norm = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.1
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_un_environment"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}

		multiply = { # Multiplied by 1.25x max
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			divide = 4
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_social_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_social"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_collectivist"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_reactionary"
			}
		}
	}
}

movement_ztrpol_antinuclear = {
	category = movement_category_ideological
	law_enactment_radicalism_multiplier = 1.5 # Single issue movement

	ideology = ideology_ztrpol_antinuclear_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_pacifist
		ideology_green
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_green
			scope:interest_group ?= {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_extreme_ambientalist
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200

			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_green
				}
			}
			multiply = 5
		}
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = counterculture
		has_technology_researched = nuclear_reactor
		OR = { ztr_has_nuclear_power_plant = yes has_global_variable = atomic_bomb_discovered }
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = { # A neighbouring country with this movement and more prestige makes it more likely
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						prestige > ROOT.prestige
						any_political_movement = { is_political_movement_type = movement_ztrpol_antinuclear }
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_uranium_full_usage }
			multiply = 2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_uranium_civil_usage }
			multiply = 1.5

		#TODO x1.25 after a nuclear power plant accident event
		if = {

		else_if = {

			multiply = 0.25
		}
	}

		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_pop_type = slaves }
	}

		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_academics

		movement_support_shopkeepers
		movement_support_clergymen
	}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement

					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}

				desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"

movement_ztrpol_pro_life = {
	category = movement_category_ideological
	law_enactment_radicalism_multiplier = 1.5 # Single issue movement

	ideology = ideology_ztrpol_pro_life_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_religious_democrat
		ideology_neoconservative
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_religious_democrat
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoconservative
			scope:interest_group ?= {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate_traditionalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_extreme_traditionalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bioethics_traditionalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_social_religious
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_religious_democratic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_clerical_nationalist
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_religious_democrat
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoconservative
				}
			}
			multiply = 5
		}
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = counterculture
		OR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_abortion
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_euthanasia
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:lgbtq_civil_unions
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:lgbtq_full_gender_equality
		}
	}
	# The cause is gone
	disband_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_abortion
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_euthanasia
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:lgbtq_civil_unions
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:lgbtq_full_gender_equality
		}
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = { # A neighbouring country with this movement and more prestige makes it more likely
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						prestige > ROOT.prestige
						any_political_movement = { is_political_movement_type = movement_ztrpol_pro_life }
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_social_pole = yes }
			multiply = 1.25
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_liberal_pole = yes }
			multiply = 1.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes }
			multiply = 0.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes }
			multiply = 0.5
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_pop_type = slaves }
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_rural
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_clergymen
		movement_support_peasants
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_aristocrats
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = clergymen }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_CLERGYMEN"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = peasants }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = farmers }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_FARMERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = aristocrats }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = upper }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = middle }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = lower }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					pop_employment_building_group = bg_agriculture
					pop_employment_building_group = bg_ranching
					pop_employment_building_group = bg_plantations
					pop_employment_building_group = bg_logging
					pop_employment_building_group = bg_fishing
					pop_employment_building_group = bg_whaling
					pop_employment_building_group = bg_manor_houses
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "RURAL_POP"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { religion = owner.religion }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_state_religion"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Literacy matters half as much
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			divide = 2
			add = 0.5
		}

		multiply = { # Multiplied by 1.25x max
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			divide = 4
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_social_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_social"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_liberal_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_liberal"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_collectivist"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_reactionary"
			}
		}
	}
}

movement_ztrpol_digital_rights = {
	category = movement_category_ideological
	law_enactment_radicalism_multiplier = 1.5 # Single issue movement

	ideology = ideology_ztrpol_digital_rights_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_new_left
		ideology_libertarian
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_new_left
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_libertarian
			scope:interest_group ?= {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_extreme_progressist
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_new_left
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_libertarian
				}
			}
			multiply = 5
		}
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = data_processing
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = { # A neighbouring country with this movement and more prestige makes it more likely
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						prestige > ROOT.prestige
						any_political_movement = { is_political_movement_type = movement_ztrpol_digital_rights }
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_data_free_harvest }
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_liberal_pole = yes }
			multiply = 1.25
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes }
			multiply = 0.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes }
			multiply = 0.5
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_pop_type = slaves }
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_engineers
		movement_support_clerks
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 10
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = academics }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = engineers }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_ENGINEERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = clerks }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_CLERKS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = upper }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = middle }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = lower }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}

		multiply = { # Multiplied by 1.25x max
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			divide = 4
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_liberal_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_liberal"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_collectivist"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_reactionary"
			}
		}
	}
}

movement_ztrpol_neoliberal = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	ideology = ideology_ztrpol_neoliberal_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_neoliberal
		ideology_libertarian
		ideology_tech_libertarian
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoliberal
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_libertarian
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_tech_libertarian
			scope:interest_group ?= {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoliberism
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_business_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_taxpayer
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoliberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_libertarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_tech_libertarian
				}
			}
			multiply = 5
		}
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = neoliberism
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = { # A neighbouring country with this movement and more prestige makes it more likely
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						prestige > ROOT.prestige
						any_political_movement = { is_political_movement_type = movement_ztrpol_neoliberal }
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_command_economy has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_interventionism } }
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_social_pole = yes }
			multiply = 1.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes }
			multiply = 0.75
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}

		NOT = { is_pop_type = slaves }
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_capitalists
		movement_support_shopkeepers
		movement_support_engineers
		movement_support_clerks
	}

				exists = scope:political_movement

					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}

				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {

						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {

						value = 0.5

movement_ztrpol_right_wing_populist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	ideology = ideology_ztrpol_right_wing_populist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_national_populist
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_populist
			scope:interest_group ?= {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_right_wing_populist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_right_wing_populist_rural
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_populist
				}
			}
			multiply = 5
		}
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = right_wing_populism
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = { # A neighbouring country with this movement and more prestige makes it more likely
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						prestige > ROOT.prestige
						any_political_movement = { is_political_movement_type = movement_ztrpol_right_wing_populist }
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_migration_controls has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_multicultural } }
			multiply = 1.5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_modifier = ztr_un_condemned_modifier }
			multiply = 1.25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_social_pole = yes }
			multiply = 1.25
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_liberal_pole = yes }
			multiply = 1.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes }
			multiply = 0.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes }
			multiply = 0.5
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_pop_type = slaves }
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_low_literacy
		movement_support_shopkeepers
		movement_support_peasants
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_laborers
		movement_support_machinists
		movement_support_unemployed
		movement_support_below_expected_sol
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 10
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = shopkeepers }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = peasants }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = farmers }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_FARMERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = laborers }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_LABORERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = machinists }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_MACHINISTS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = upper }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = middle }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = lower }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { standard_of_living < state.average_expected_sol }
			add = {
				desc = "IS_BELOW_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				max = 10
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_employed = no }
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "UNEMPLOYED"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Stronger among the less literate: x1.25 at 0, x0.75 at 1
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			divide = -2
			add = 1.25
		}

		multiply = { # Multiplied by 1.25x max
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			divide = 4
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_social_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_social"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_liberal_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_liberal"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_collectivist"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_reactionary"
			}
		}
	}
}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_laborers
		movement_support_machinists
		movement_support_unemployed
		movement_support_ztrpol_un_wto
		movement_support_ztrpol_imf
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 10
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = academics }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = laborers }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_LABORERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = machinists }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_MACHINISTS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = upper }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = middle }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = lower }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_employed = no }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "UNEMPLOYED"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_un_wto_norm = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.1
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_un_wto"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_imf_modifier = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.2
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_imf"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}

		multiply = { # Multiplied by 1.25x max
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			divide = 4
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_liberal_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_liberal"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.25
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_collectivist"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes } }
			multiply = {
				value = 0.25
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_pole_reactionary"
			}
		}
	}
}

movement_ztrpol_democratization = {
	category = movement_category_ideological
	active_law_radicalism_multiplier = 1.5 # Repressive laws in force radicalize

	ideology = ideology_ztrpol_democratization_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_democratizer
		ideology_reform_communist
		ideology_liberal_leader
		ideology_humanitarian
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_democratizer
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reform_communist
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_leader
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
			scope:interest_group ?= {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_progressive_secular
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_social_democratic_labor
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_democratizer
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reform_communist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_leader
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
				}
			}
			multiply = 5
		}
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = socialdemocracy
		OR = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes }
	}
	disband_trigger = {
		NOT = { OR = { ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes } }
		has_variable = liberty_index_var
		var:liberty_index_var >= 60
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = { # A neighbouring country with this movement and more prestige makes it more likely
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = {
						prestige > ROOT.prestige
						any_political_movement = { is_political_movement_type = movement_ztrpol_democratization }
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_technology_researched = transnational_activism }
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_modifier = ztr_un_condemned_modifier }
			multiply = 1.5
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_pop_type = slaves }
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_clerks
		movement_support_cultural_discrimination
		movement_support_below_expected_sol
		movement_support_ztrpol_un_condemned
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 15
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = academics }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = clerks }
			add = {
				value = 9
				desc = "POP_CLERKS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = upper }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = middle }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { strata = lower }
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_4 }
			add = { # Up to +7.5 at acceptance 0
				desc = "POP_DISCRIMINATED"
				value = acceptance_status_4
				subtract = pop_acceptance
				divide = acceptance_status_4
				multiply = 7.5
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { standard_of_living < state.average_expected_sol }
			add = {
				desc = "IS_BELOW_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				max = 5
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_modifier = ztr_un_condemned_modifier } }
			multiply = {
				value = 1.1
				desc = "ztrpol_movement_un_condemned"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}

		multiply = { # Multiplied by 1.25x max
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			divide = 4
			add = 1
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}
		weight = {
			value = 100
		}
		state_weight = {
			value = state_urbanization_rate
			add = scope:clout
			add = { value = this.turmoil divide = 2 }
			subtract = this.loyalists
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							NOT = { THIS = ROOT.owner }
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_ztrpol_democratization
								is_insurrectionary = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				this.days_since_movement_defeated <= very_long_modifier_time
			}
			add = { # (x-y)/y - ([1, 7300]-7300)/7300
				desc = "movement_suppressed_after_civil_war"
				value = this.days_since_movement_defeated
				subtract = very_long_modifier_time
				divide = {
					value = very_long_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
